correctness.rationale: The S3 exact-degree normalized reproducing kernel is U_k(t)/(k+1). The ten A4 positive roots have mutual dot products 1,0,±1/2; their odd Gram reduces to oriented K5 incidence and their even Gram reduces to the Johnson graph J(5,2). Multiplicities and eigenvalues follow from explicit 5-by-10 incidence identities. Chebyshev values at 0 and 1/2 belong to {0,±1}/(k+1). Direct exact low-degree values combined with uniform analytic inequalities for odd k>=5 and even k>=12 prove ranks 1,4,9,10 thereafter, all-degree frame bounds 2/11 and 22/13, the unique bound-attaining degrees, condition number max six exactly at k=3,10, and tightness exactly for k congruent to five mod six. The package checker independently computes 301 rational Gram matrices; finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The A4 root orbit is a canonical twenty-point spherical configuration. Exact all-degree harmonic sampling and condition of its Gram kernel are natural quantitative invariants. The result proves a uniform, sharp lower and upper frame bound over infinitely many degrees, a non-obvious two-degree maximizer for the worst condition, unique extremal frame-bound degrees, and infinitely many exactly tight degrees, yielding stable parity interpolation and its sharp two-degree threshold. This is a self-contained structural classification rather than an arbitrary finite numerical slice.
